# fn-8-4v9.3 Wire setActiveTool in MapCanvas useEffect

## Description
Wire up setActiveTool call in MapCanvas when activeTool changes.

## Implementation

Add useEffect in MapCanvas.tsx:

```typescript
// After the existing surveyLayerRef useEffects
useEffect(() => {
  if (surveyLayerRef.current) {
    surveyLayerRef.current.setActiveTool(activeTool);
  }
}, [activeTool]);
```

This ensures:
1. SurveyLayer knows the current tool at all times
2. Hover state is cleared when switching to pan/zoom
3. Visual state is updated immediately on tool switch
## Acceptance
- [ ] useEffect calls surveyLayerRef.current.setActiveTool(activeTool)
- [ ] useEffect has [activeTool] dependency
- [ ] Hover clears immediately when switching to Zoom tool
- [ ] Hover clears immediately when switching to Pan tool
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-8-4v9.5 Update documentation and changelog

## Description
Update documentation for the non-interactive tool behavior.

## Keyboard Shortcuts Documentation

Update `docs/keyboard-shortcuts.md` to note:

> **Note**: Selection shortcuts (S for select tool) and feature-related shortcuts are disabled when Pan (P) or Zoom (Z) tools are active. Switch back to Select tool to interact with stations and shots.

## Changelog

Add entry to `CHANGELOG.md`:

```markdown
### Fixed
- Zoom and Pan tools no longer allow selection of stations/shots
- Hover effects disabled for Zoom and Pan tools
- Context menu disabled for Zoom and Pan tools
- Switching to Zoom/Pan clears any active hover state
```
